blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.
blocks.zh: 接触不足会削弱物体细节,而过度接触会模糊边界. 斯派克相机将光线编码成高频二进制流. 长窗钉子的计数提供了稳定的外观提示,而短暂的观测显示,从零星的测量中,燃烧率有所变化。 我们提出SPIRE,一个传感器定位的语义活化框架,用于从单一的悬崖流中探测出发光-活性物体。 SPIRE通过以检测为导向的照明改造从全包中构建出外观,并构建出从逐渐更长的前缀中累积的视图序列. 每个前缀都提供一个速率图,边缘图,以及随着悬赏累积而跟踪变化的速率差. 在所选择的尺度上,ANN特性和突起初始化共同设定了初始膜潜能值和发火阈值,允许语义提示在时间编码时塑造出响应. 在培训期间,各地的挂钩比对监督这两个部门。 所测量到的和ANN预想的对比值之间的残存与平起伏的特征结合,对被引信的地物金字塔产生有限度的校正. 在模拟VOC和COCO时,SPIRE-D在四个低暴露度和超暴露度设置上比最强基线高出4.00-5.50 AP50分. 在真实的PKU-Vidar-DVD录音上,它实现了67.07 AP50和40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D也使用比SPFD少50.4%的MAC.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Extreme illumination remains a major challenge for object detection in autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance. Underexposure weakens visual details and amplifies noise, while overexposure obscures discriminative structures. Although task-oriented image processing and RAW-domain detection alleviate such degradation [ 22 , 17 , 10 ] , frame-based cameras remain constrained by exposure-dependent information acquisition. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , event cameras provide high temporal resolution but primarily capture relative brightness changes, offering limited intensity information in static regions [ 8 , 21 ] . In contrast, spike cameras encode accumulated incident light through high-frequency binary measurements [ 12 , 42 ] , providing a promising sensing modality for illumination-robust object detection.
blocks.zh: 极端照明仍然是在自主驾驶、机器人和监视中探测物体的主要挑战。 暴露不足会削弱视觉细节并放大噪音,而过度暴露则会模糊歧视结构. 虽然面向任务的图像处理和RAW-域域检测可以缓解这种降解[22,17,10],但基于帧的相机仍然受到依赖曝光的信息获取的限制. 如图一所示,事件相机提供高时间分辨率,但主要捕捉相对亮度变化,在静态区域提供强度信息有限[8,21]. 相形之下,悬崖相机通过高频二进制测量[12,42]来编码所积累的事件光,为照明-活性物体探测提供了一种很有希望的感知方式.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Imaging comparison. RGB cameras suffer from exposure-dependent degradation, while event cameras capture relative brightness changes. Spike cameras retain intensity-related information through high-frequency binary sampling.
blocks.zh: 图1:图像比较。 RGB相机受到受接触依赖降解的影响,而事件相机则捕捉出相对亮度的变化. 斯派克相机通过高频二进制取样保留了与强度有关的信息.

blocks.en: A spike packet supports several complementary measurements. Integrating over the full packet stabilizes the appearance estimate, as exploited in spike reconstruction and perception [ 37 , 4 , 24 ] . Observing the same packet at successive times exposes changes in firing rates that a single average compresses. Spatial differences in accumulated counts capture local structure, including in stationary regions. These signals serve different roles in detection. The full packet supports semantic recognition, the sequence of observations drives temporal encoding, and spatial count contrasts provide a reference for refining the fused features. RGB-event and hybrid ANN-SNN detectors demonstrate the value of combining complementary features [ 3 , 1 , 33 ] . SPIRE connects the two representations during neuronal encoding and brings the count measurements back into the detection path after fusion.
blocks.zh: 一个螺旋包支持若干辅助测量。 整包的整合稳定了外观估计值,利用了尖锐的重建和感知[37、4、24]。 连续观察同一包会暴露一个平均压缩的发火率的变化。 累积数的空间差异反映当地结构,包括固定区域的结构。 这些信号在探测中起到不同的作用. 完整数据包支持语义识别,观测序列驱动了时间编码,空间计数对比为完善被引信的特征提供了参考. RGB-event和混合式ANN-SNN探测器显示结合互补特征[3, 1, 33]的价值. SPIRE在神经元编码过程中将两种表达方式连接起来,并将计数测量结果带回聚变后的检测路径.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose SPIRE , a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking illumination-robust estimation for object detection using a single spike modality. To reconcile stable appearance estimation with temporal evidence preservation, SPIRE constructs two complementary views from the same spike stream. A semantic appearance branch employs detection-oriented illumination adaptation and an ANN encoder to extract discriminative semantic features from full-window spike statistics. In parallel, a temporal-structural branch constructs cumulative rate, edge, and inter-prefix difference representations, which are processed by a spiking encoder. These cumulative observations capture the evolution of spike statistics while mitigating the instability of isolated short-window measurements.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出SPIRE, 一种传感器定位的语义活化-发光-活性估计, 用于使用单一的突起模式探测物体。 为了调和稳定的外观估计和时间证据保存,SPIRE从同一悬崖流中构建出两种互补观点. 一个语义外观分支采用以检测为导向的照明适应和ANN编码器,从全窗口尖端统计中提取出有区别的语义特征. 同时,一个时间-结构分支构建出累积率,边缘,和前缀间差表示,由一跃起的编码器处理. 这些累积观测捕捉了尖峰统计的演变,同时减轻了孤立的短窗测量的不稳定性.

blocks.en: SPIRE introduces semantic-guided spiking encoding to connect the two branches during feature generation. Inspired by neuronal configuration mechanisms [ 20 ] , we combine ANN-derived semantic prompts with spike-derived initialization to configure the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds of spiking neurons at selected scales. These initial states and thresholds let semantic cues shape the spiking responses before cross-stream feature fusion.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we introduce measurement-guided refinement to maintain an explicit connection between learned representations and raw spike observations. Specifically, normalized contrasts between neighboring spike counts provide observation-derived structural references for supervising both semantic and spiking branches. During inference, SPIRE combines the ANN contrast residual with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused features. We evaluate SPIRE under simulated under- and overexposure and on real spike recordings.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们引入了计量指导的改进方法,以在学到的陈述和原始突起观察之间保持明确的联系。 具体地说,相邻的指针计数之间的正态对比为监督语义分支和尖锐分支提供了观察衍生的结构参考. 在推论中,SPIRE结合了ANN对比残基和生平特征,对被引信的特征产生有限度的校正. 我们通过模拟曝光度过低和过高 以及真实记录来评估SPIRE

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold. • We establish a single-source spike detection framework that jointly exploits complementary semantic appearance and cumulative temporal-structural representations. • We develop semantic-guided spiking encoding that incorporates ANN semantics and spike-derived initialization into neuronal state configuration, enabling interaction during temporal encoding. • We introduce measurement-guided refinement that leverages raw spike-count contrasts for cross-branch supervision and bounded feature correction, achieving robust detection across challenging illumination conditions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Detection under Challenging Illumination
blocks.zh: 2.1 在有挑战性的照明下检测

blocks.en: Illumination-robust detection has been explored through task-aware image processing [ 22 ] , day-night adaptation [ 6 ] , and RAW-domain learning [ 17 , 10 ] . Event cameras further support challenging-light perception, motivating nighttime reconstruction [ 21 ] and RGB-event detection [ 3 , 33 ] . In particular, SPFD [ 33 ] disentangles shared and modality-specific features to exploit complementary RGB-event information. SPIRE studies the single-sensor setting, where appearance and temporal structure must both be recovered from an intensity-encoding spike stream.
blocks.zh: 通过任务感知图像处理[22],昼夜适应[6],以及RAW-域内学习[17,10],探索了光能活度探测. 事件相机进一步支持挑战光感知,推动夜间重建[21]和RGB-事件探测[3,33]. 特别是,SPFD[33]将共享的和模式特有的特征分解,以利用互补的RGB活动信息. SPIRE研究了单传感器设置,其中外观和时间结构都必须从加强度编码的尖刺流中恢复.

blocks.en: 2.2 Spike-Camera Representation and Perception
blocks.zh: 2.2 斯派克-卡梅拉的代表和看法

blocks.en: Spike cameras encode intensity-related information through high-frequency binary measurements [ 12 , 42 ] . Prior studies investigate image reconstruction [ 37 , 40 ] , optical flow [ 38 ] , color recovery, and temporal modeling [ 5 , 4 , 34 ] . For object detection, Driving in Spikes [ 24 ] exploits complementary spike representations and entropy-guided feature selection for object detection. SPIRE uses cumulative views for temporal encoding, configures the spiking neurons with semantic cues, and refines detection features with raw spike-count contrasts.
blocks.zh: Spike相机通过高频二进制测量编码强度相关信息[12,42]. 先前的研究调查了图像重建[37,40],光学流[38],颜色恢复,以及时间模型[5,4,34]. 对于物体检测,"Spikes [24]"中的"驱动"利用了互补的"突起"表示和" en-导"特性选择来进行物体检测. SPIRE使用累积视图来进行时间编码,用语义提示来配置尖锐的神经元,并用原始的戳数对比来完善检测特征.

blocks.en: 2.3 Event Detection and Semantic-Spiking Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.3 事件检测和语义 -- -- 溢出相互作用

blocks.en: Event-based detection has advanced through recurrent attention [ 9 ] , sparse Transformers [ 28 ] , and adaptive spiking representations [ 35 , 15 , 18 ] . Related methods explore semantic feature refinement [ 14 ] and hybrid ANN-SNN perception [ 1 ] , primarily emphasizing feature transformation and interaction. ClearSight [ 20 ] further introduces semantic-guided neuronal configuration for event-assisted deblurring. SPIRE applies semantic-guided neuronal configuration to cumulative spike representations for detection. It also uses intensity-related information in stationary regions to guide feature refinement with raw spike counts.
blocks.zh: 基于事件的探测通过经常性的注意[9]、稀少的变形器[28]和适应性的尖锐表述[35、15、18]得到了推进。 相關方法探索语义特征精炼[14]和杂交的ANN-SNN感知[1],主要强调特征转化和相互作用. ClearSight [20] 进一步引入了由语义引导的神经元构型,用于事件辅助分解. SPIRE将语义导神经构型应用于累积的突起表示以进行检测. 它还在固定区域使用与强度有关的信息,以原始分数来指导特征的改进。

blocks.en: We evaluate SPIRE on PASCAL VOC [ 7 ] , MS COCO [ 19 ] , and PKU-Vidar-DVS [ 16 ] . For VOC, we train on VOC2007+2012 trainval and evaluate on VOC2007 test across 20 categories, considering underexposure ( 0.2 × 0.2\times ) and overexposure ( 5.0 × 5.0\times ). For COCO, we use train2017/val2017 with 80 categories. Both datasets are converted into Bayer-patterned spike streams using an integrate-and-fire simulator. PKU-Vidar-DVS contains real monochrome spike recordings across nine categories. We follow its provided training and validation splits and use the monochrome spike recordings as SPIRE’s input. The simulated benchmarks test detection at specified exposure conditions, and PKU-Vidar-DVS tests the same method on data from a physical sensor.
blocks.zh: 我们评价PASCAL VOC [7],MS CO [19],以及PKU-Vidar-DVD [16]。 对于VOC,我们通过VOC2007+2012列车val进行训练,并在VOC2007测试中评价20个类别,考虑出低曝光度(0.2×0.2\时)和高曝光度(5.0×5.0\时). 对于COCO,我们使用2017/val2017次列车,共80个类别. 两个数据集都被用集成相火模拟器转换为由拜耳标定的悬崖流. PKU-Vidar-DVS包含9个类别中真实的单色突起录音. 我们遵循其提供的培训和验证分解,并使用单色悬索录音作为SPIRE的投入。 模拟基准测试检测在规定的接触条件下进行,PKU-Vidar-DVD测试在物理传感器的数据上采用同样的方法.

blocks.en: We report AP 50 and AP 75 at IoU thresholds of 0.50 and 0.75, respectively. Reporting both metrics shows how each method performs when a tighter box match is required.
blocks.zh: 我们报告AP50和AP75的IOU阈值分别为0.50和0.75. 报告这两种衡量标准都显示在需要更严格的框匹配时每种方法如何运作。

blocks.en: SPIRE adopts CSPDarknet-Tiny [ 32 ] and DINOv3-pretrained ConvNeXt-Tiny [ 23 , 30 ] as semantic backbones. We refer to the two configurations as SPIRE-C and SPIRE-D, respectively. We use 200-frame simulated Bayer spikes at 320 × 320 320\times 320 and 400-frame real Vidar spikes at 416 × 416 416\times 416 , with four cumulative SNN steps. Models are trained using AdamW with a learning rate and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , except for DINOv3 parameters with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Training lasts 50 epochs on VOC/COCO and 10 epochs on PKU-Vidar-DVS, with a two-epoch warmup, learning rate decay, and EMA evaluation. The measurement loss weight reaches 0.01 0.01 after the ramp-up.
blocks.zh: SPIRE采用CSPDAKNET-TINY [32]和DINov3预训ConvNEXt-TINY [23,30]作为语义骨干. 我们把这两个配置分别称为SPIRE-C和SPIRE-D. 我们使用200帧模拟的拜耳钉 在320×320 320\时和400帧 真正的维达尔钉 在416×416\时, 四个累积SNN步骤。 模型使用AdamW进行训练,学习率和体重衰减为10 - 4 10- 4},除了DINov3参数的学习率为10 - 5 10- 5}。 培训持续了50个世纪,涉及VOC/COCO,10个世纪,涉及PKU-Vidar-DVS,有2个世纪的热身,学习率衰减,以及EMA评价. 测量损失重量在坡道后达到0.01.

blocks.en: The simulated VOC and COCO experiments include RGB-event fusion models and detectors that take spike inputs. On PKU-Vidar-DVS, we include methods using real events or real spikes and list the input for each method in the corresponding table.
blocks.zh: 模拟的VOC和COCO实验包括RGB-事件聚变模型和取出突起输入的探测器. 在PKU-Vidar-DVD上,我们包含使用真实事件或真实突起的方法,并在相应的表格中列出每种方法的输入.

blocks.en: 4.2 Detection Accuracy
blocks.zh: 4.2 检测准确性

blocks.en: Table 1 : Quantitative comparison on VOC and COCO under exposure degradation. RGB+E denotes RGB and events. Best and second-best values are shown in bold and underlined text, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:在接触降解情况下对挥发性有机化合物和COCO的定量比较。 RGB+E表示RGB和事件. 最佳和次最佳值分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: SPIRE-D leads on both AP metrics across the four settings in Tab. 1 . On VOC, it reaches 79.59/63.23 AP 50 /AP 75 under underexposure and 77.69/60.32 under overexposure. Relative to SPFD, the strongest baseline in the table, the gains are 4.32/5.51 and 5.50/5.14 points, respectively. On COCO, the AP 50 gains are 4.00 and 4.53 points, and the corresponding AP 75 gains are 4.73 and 4.34 points. The gains thus extend to detection at the stricter overlap threshold on both datasets.
blocks.zh: SPIRE-D在Tab的四个设置中领先两个AP度量衡. 1. 在VOC上,接触不足者达到79.59/63.23 AP 50/AP 75;接触过度者达到77.69/60.32。 相对于表内最强基线的SPFD,增益分别为4.32/5.51分和5.50/5.14分. 在COCO上,AP50的得分是4.00分和4.53分,相应的AP75的得分是4.73分和4.34分. 因此,收益扩大到在两个数据集更严格的重叠阈值检测。

blocks.en: Across the two tested exposure settings, SPIRE-D’s AP 50 decreases by 1.90 points on VOC and 1.80 on COCO from underexposure to overexposure. The corresponding decreases for SPFD are 3.08 and 2.33 points. SPIRE-C also exceeds SpikeYOLO, the highest-scoring spike-input baseline in the simulated comparison, by 7.55-8.57 AP 50 points across these four settings. This comparison shows that the compact configuration also offers a consistent gain within the spike input modality.
blocks.zh: 在两个经过测试的接触环境中,SPIRE-D的AP 50在VOC上减少了1.90分,在COCO上减少了1.80分,从接触不足降至接触过多。 战略规划和方案预算的相应减少为3.08和2.33分。 SPIRE-C也超过了SpikeYOLO,这是模拟比较中最高得分的悬浮投注基线,在这四个设置中共超过7.55-8.57 AP 50分. 这一比较表明,紧凑的配置也为激增输入模式提供了持续的收益。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Quantitative comparison on PKU-Vidar-DVS. Best and second-best are shown in bold and underlined , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2:与PKU-Vidar-DVD的定量比较。 最佳和第二最佳分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: On PKU-Vidar-DVS ( Tab. 2 ), SPIRE-D reaches 67.07 AP 50 and 40.10 AP 75 , exceeding SPFD by 3.95 and 0.52 points, respectively. The larger gain at IoU 0.50 shows that the advantage is stronger at the more permissive threshold on these real recordings. SPIRE-C reaches 63.27 AP 50 , close to SPFD’s 63.12, while its AP 75 is 1.82 points lower. Among the other methods with spike inputs, SPIRE-D improves AP 50 by 4.09 points over SpikeYOLO and by 6.97 points over EASD.
blocks.zh: 在PKU-Vidar-DVS上(图2),SPIRE-D达到67.07 AP 50和40.10 AP 75,分别超过CPFD3.95和0.52分. IoU 0.50的较大收益表明,在这些真实录音上,在更宽容的门槛上,优势更大. SPIRE-C达到63.27 AP 50,接近SPFD的63.12,而它的AP 75则低了1.82分. 在有尖锐投入的其他方法中,SPIRE-D比斯派克YOLO改进了AP504.09分,比EASD改进了6.97分.

blocks.en: 4.3 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.3 计算效率

blocks.en: Table 3 : Detection accuracy and inference cost on PKU-Vidar-DVS and VOC-UE. PKU denotes PKU-Vidar-DVS, and VOC-UE denotes underexposed VOC. Best and second-best values are shown in bold and underlined text, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表3:PKU-Vidar-DVD和VOC-UE的检测精度和推论成本。 PKU表示PKU-Vidar-DVD,而VOC-UE表示接触不足的VOC. 最佳和次最佳值分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: Tab. 3 compares accuracy with parameter count, MACs, and inference latency. SPIRE-D uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD (62.7 vs. 126.3), with a latency of 60.9 ms versus 65.4 ms and higher AP at both IoU thresholds on the two benchmarks. SPIRE-C has the lowest MAC count (46.7). Compared with SpikeYOLO, SPIRE-C gains 7.55 AP 50 points on underexposed VOC and 0.29 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS, with 20.5 ms higher measured latency.
blocks.zh: Tab. 3 将精确度与参数计数,MAC,和推论延迟度进行比较. SPIRE-D使用的MAC比SPFD(62.7 vs 126.3)少了50.4%,耐用度为60.9 ms相比为65.4 ms相比,两个基准的IoU阈值均高于AP. SPIRE-C的MAC计数最低(46.7). 与斯派克YOLO相比,SPIRE-C在未充分曝光的VOC上获得了7.55 AP 50分,PKU-Vidar-DVS上获得了0.29分,测得的空闲度高了20.5 ms.

blocks.en: Within SPIRE, moving from the compact to the larger configuration adds 4.1 ms of latency and improves AP 50 by 3.80 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS and 15.61 points on underexposed VOC. The accuracy return from the larger configuration is thus substantially greater on underexposed VOC in this comparison.
blocks.zh: 在SPIRE内部,从紧凑到更大的配置增加了4.1 ms的耐久性并改进了AP 50在PKU-Vidar-DVS上的3.80分和在曝光不足的VOC上的15.61分. 因此,在比较中,未充分暴露的VOC从更大的配置中获得的准确性回报要高得多。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: All ablations use SPIRE-C to keep the semantic backbone fixed. This minimizes the influence of a powerful semantic backbone, allowing us to better isolate the contributions of the proposed modules. We train for 10 epochs on PKU-Vidar-DVS and 50 epochs on VOC under both exposures.
blocks.zh: 所有的活塞都使用SPIRE-C来固定语义主干. 这将强大的语义骨干的影响降到了最低,使我们能够更好地孤立拟议模块的贡献. 我们在PKU-Vidar-DVS上为10个纪元进行训练,在两次曝光下为VOC上为50个纪元进行训练.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation of key components in SPIRE-C. UE and OE denote under- and overexposure, respectively. Best and second-best values are shown in bold and underlined , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表4:SPIRE-C. UE和OE中关键成分的缩放分别表示接触不足和过度。 最佳和次最佳数值分别以粗体和下划线表示。

blocks.en: In Tab. 4 , adding the spiking branch and associated modules to the ANN-only configuration improves AP 50 by 4.01 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS and by 3.48 and 3.88 points under VOC under- and overexposure. The largest single-removal effects differ by setting. Removing the adaptive ISP gives the largest AP 50 drops among the component removals on VOC (7.46 and 6.84 points), consistent with its role in adapting the appearance input to exposure. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS, removing cross-stream interaction gives the largest drop (4.14 points), suggesting that how the two feature streams are combined matters particularly on this benchmark. Removing measurement-guided refinement lowers AP 50 in all three settings, by 2.56 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS and by 3.47 and 3.72 points on VOC.
blocks.zh: 在 Tab. 4 中,将 spiking 分支和相关模块添加到 ANN 唯一的配置中,在 PKU-Vidar-DVS 上将 AP 50 改进 4.01分,在 VOC 下增加 3.48分和 3.88分. 最大的单一迁移效应因设定不同而不同。 删除适应性的ISP在VOC(7.46和6.84分)的组件去除量中给予最大AP50滴,这符合其在使外观输入适应暴露方面的作用。 在真实的PKU-Vidar-DVD上,去除跨流交互给出了最大的下降(4.14分),说明这两个特征流是如何结合的,特别是在这个基准上. 移除测量-导精度后,AP50在所有三种设置中都会降低,PKU-Vidar-DVS的分数为2.56分,VOC的分数为3.47分和3.72分.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Ablation of temporal inputs and neuronal dynamics. Static denotes a full-window input, and cumulative denotes the four ordered prefix views. Best and second-best values are shown in bold and underlined text, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表5:时间输入和神经动力学的分化. 静态表示一个全窗口输入,累积表示四个顺序前缀视图. 最佳和次最佳值分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: Tab. 5 varies the input representation and neuron type. Under LIF encoding, cumulative inputs improve AP 50 by 2.00 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS and by 4.36 and 3.27 points under VOC under- and overexposure. With cumulative inputs fixed, LIF improves AP 50 /AP 75 by 2.05/2.40 points over non-spiking encoding on real recordings. On VOC, the cumulative non-spiking variant instead leads the cumulative LIF variant by 0.50 and 0.37 AP 50 points. On the same real data, the static LIF variant scores 0.49 AP 50 points below the static non-spiking variant. The advantage of LIF on PKU-Vidar-DVS thus depends on giving the encoder a sequence of cumulative inputs in this ablation.
blocks.zh: Tab. 5不同输入表示和神经元类型. 在LIF编码下,累积输入在PKU-Vidar-DVD上改进了AP 50 2.00分,在VOC下改进了4.36分和3.27分. 随着累积输入的固定,LIF将AP 50/AP 75比真实录音的非悬浮编码改进了2.05/2.40分. 在VOC上,累积的非悬浮变体取而代之的是累积的LIF变体0.50和0.37 AP 50分. 在同一真实数据上,静态LIF变体在静态非悬浮变体下方得分为0.49 AP 50分. 因此,LIF在PKU-Vidar-DVS上的优势取决于在此缩写中给编码器一个累积输入的序列.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Ablation of cumulative inputs and semantic-guided neuron configuration. Cum. denotes cumulative inputs. Best and second-best are shown in bold and underlined , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表6:累积输入和语义导神经元构型的缩放. Cum.表示累计投入. 最佳和第二最佳分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: Tab. 6 crosses the use of cumulative inputs with the use of semantic prompts. With cumulative inputs fixed, prompting improves AP 50 /AP 75 by 0.83/1.78 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS. On VOC, the AP 50 gains from prompting are 2.61 and 2.95 points with cumulative inputs, compared with 0.81 and 1.70 points with static inputs. On VOC, cumulative inputs increase the gain from prompting by 1.80 points under underexposure and 1.25 points under overexposure. On PKU-Vidar-DVS, prompting improves AP 75 by 2.13 points with static inputs and 1.78 points with cumulative inputs. The prompt improves detection with either input on real recordings, while the larger prompt gains with cumulative inputs are observed for VOC AP 50 .
blocks.zh: Tab. 6通过使用语义提示来交叉使用累积输入. 在固定了累计输入后,提示在PKU-Vidar-DVS上将AP 50/AP 75改进0.83/1.78分. 在VOC上,AP50从催化得到的收益为2.61分和2.95分并有累积投入,而0.81分和1.70分则有静态投入. 在VOC上,累积投入增加了在接触不足下出动1.80分和在过度接触下出动1.25分的出动收益. 在PKU-Vidar-DVS上,以静态输入来推动AP 75改进2.13分,以累积输入来改进1.78分. 迅速改进了对真实录音输入的探测,而VOC AP 50记录了在累积输入方面的较大迅速收益。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation of measurement-guided refinement. Supervision enables the auxiliary count-contrast loss during training. Correction enables the masked residual update to the fused pyramid. Best and second-best values are shown in bold and underlined text, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表7:计量指导改进办法的调整。 监督使辅助计数连续器在训练期间丧失。 纠正后可以将被蒙住的残留更新到被保险的金字塔. 最佳和次最佳值分别以黑体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparisons on VOC underexposure scenes. The columns show the spike frames, SPFD, EOLO, SPIRE-D, SPIRE-D feature heatmaps, and ground-truth boxes.
blocks.zh: 图4:VOC曝光不足场景定性比较. 栏中显示钉框、SPFD、EOLO、SPIRE-D、SPIRE-D等特性的热图和地上真能盒。

blocks.en: Tab. 7 isolates the training-time contrast supervision from the feature correction. On PKU-Vidar-DVS, each component alone changes AP 50 by at most 0.60 points, while enabling both improves AP 50 /AP 75 by 2.56/3.39 points over the variant with neither. On VOC, either component alone lowers AP 50 under both exposure settings. Enabling both raises AP 50 by 3.47 and 3.72 points over the variant with neither. The effect of enabling correction depends on whether the contrast predictions are supervised. With supervision, correction raises AP 50 by 2.33 points on PKU-Vidar-DVS and by 5.32 and 5.19 points under VOC under- and overexposure. Without supervision, the change is +0.60, -0.61, and -1.56 points, respectively. This pattern supports the role of the supervised contrast predictions in making the residual correction useful for detection.
blocks.zh: Tab.7将培训时间对比监督与特征校正隔离. 在PKU-Vidar-DVS上,每个组件单以最多0.60分修改了AP 50,同时使两者均能将AP 50/AP 75在变体上改进为 2.56/3.39分,但两者均无. 在VOC上,单是两个组件都降低了AP 50在两种接触环境中的水平。 两者都使AP50以3.47和3.72的分数高于变体,两者均无一例外。 促成校正的效果取决于对比预测是否受到监督. 在监督下,校正将AP50在PKU-Vidar-DVD上以2.33分提升,在VOC下以5.32分和5.19分提升到接触不足和过度. 没有监督,变化分别为+0.60,-0.61和-1.56分. 这种模式支持有监督的对比预测在使剩余校正用于检测方面的作用.

blocks.en: 4.5 Qualitative Results and Class-Wise Recall
blocks.zh: 4.5 定性结果和班级回顾

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows representative underexposed VOC scenes. In these examples, SPIRE-D produces fewer redundant boxes and closer matches to the annotated boxes than SPFD and EOLO. The accompanying heatmaps show the spatial distribution of SPIRE-D’s feature responses around the objects. Notably, SPIRE-D maintains reliable detections in scenes containing multiple objects and weakened visual details, where competing methods exhibit missed or inaccurate predictions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SPIRE in maintaining robust object perception from sparse spike observations.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了代表性曝光度不足的VOC场景. 在这些例子中,SPIRE-D生产的冗余箱和与附加说明的箱更接近的匹配比SPFD和EOLO更少. 附带的热图显示SPIRE-D的特征反应围绕物体的空间分布. 值得注意的是,SPIRE-D在包含多个物体和被削弱的视觉细节的场景中保持了可靠的检测功能,在这些场景中,相竞方法显示的预测偏差或不准确. 这些结果表明,SPIRE通过稀有的突起观测,有效地维持了强烈的物体感知。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Class-wise recall under simulated and real spike scenes. (a) VOC underexposure. (b) PKU-Vidar-DVS.
blocks.zh: 图5:模拟和真实的悬崖场景下的经典召回。 (a) VOC接触不足。 (b) PKU-Vidar-DVD。

blocks.en: Fig. 5 compares class-wise recall on underexposed VOC and real PKU-Vidar-DVS. SPIRE-D achieves higher recall across multiple categories, while SPIRE-C remains competitive despite its lightweight backbone. The improvements are observed in both simulated low-light conditions and real spike recordings, indicating the robustness of SPIRE across different observation settings. These results suggest that complementary semantic and temporal-structural representations help preserve discriminative object evidence, reducing missed detections under challenging illumination and real spike observations.
blocks.zh: 图5比较了未充分暴露的VOC和真实的PKU-Vidar-DVD的分级召回. SPIRE-D在多个类别中实现更高的召回,而SPIRE-C尽管具有轻量级骨干,但仍然具有竞争力. 在模拟低光条件下和真实的悬崖记录中都观察到这些改进,这表明SPIRE在不同观测环境中的坚固性. 这些结果表明,补充的语义和时间结构表述有助于保留歧视性物体证据,减少在有挑战性的照明和真正的悬崖观测下被错失的探测。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking illumination-robust estimation for object detection using a single spike modality. SPIRE constructs complementary semantic and temporal-structural representations, with semantic cues configuring membrane potentials and firing thresholds before cross-stream fusion. Measurement-guided refinement further incorporates raw spike-count evidence into feature correction. Extensive experiments on simulated and real spike recordings demonstrate robust detection performance with favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SPIRE, 一种传感器定位的语义活化光线活化-活性能估计, 用于使用单一的突起模式探测物体。 SPIRE构建了互补的语义和时间结构表述,语义提示在跨流聚变前配置出膜潜力和发火阈值. 计量指导的完善进一步将原始的钉入计算证据纳入特征校正。 对模拟录音和真实录音进行的广泛试验显示,检测性能强劲,精度效率优异。
